prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.1%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Move sign-in after pet adoption', 'Waiting Screen Progress Timer', 'Move sign-in after waiting screen', 'Story Screen Compact Layout']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Interactive tip carousel on waiting screen', 'Desktop display shortcut hint on final intro screen', 'Desktop habitat selection screen', 'Background generation wait hint', 'One-click sign in copy tweak', 'Photo upload quality checker widget', 'Structured Photo Upload Flow', 'Desktop Visibility Check Screen', 'Sign-In Pet Persistence Copy Clarification', 'Mascot Welcome Incentive', 'Quick Start Preset Adoption Flow', 'Time Remaining Countdown Estimate', 'Home Intro Companion Controls Guide Badge']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Add dedicated desktop controls tutorial screen', 'Preset selection preview flow for custom pet photo upload', 'Account sign-in warning copy for pet sync', 'Split layout for choose path screen', 'Adoption certificate starter accessory badge', 'Stage layout redesign for pet selection', 'Post-intro sign-in reorder', 'Interactive pet naming flow', 'Grid layout for path options', 'First-day treat starter gift incentive', 'Adoption Certificate Spotlight Redesign', 'Photo Upload Guidelines Helper Copy']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Predictions were generally overoptimistic for large changes, though winning tests were often underpredicted.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) consistently worked and proved helpful across 2 tests.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy) and new adoption flows (adoption, new_flow) showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Evidence remains thin for all other change types (hints, incentives, redesigns, layout changes, and home wait info) due to single tests or mixed results.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Move sign-in after custom photo upload
candidates.change: Move the sign-in screen to take place after photo upload and pet selection but before the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Reordering sign-in later in the funnel has consistently shown strong performance in prior tests, allowing users to pick or create their pet first.

candidates.title: Pick friend screen carousel redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen to use a carousel layout featuring dynamic preview components for each pet option.
candidates.why: Adoption has a relatively low conversion rate (60.9%) and long completion times (median 89s / mean 1017s); a carousel layout makes pet browsing smoother.

candidates.title: Interactive photo upload checklist flow
candidates.change: Convert photo upload into a guided checklist sub-flow with mascot instructions for custom pet creation.
candidates.why: Support emails highlight issues where custom pets fail or look wrong (3 emails), and adoption drop-off is high.

components.text: Follow these simple steps for the best pet creation result!

candidates.title: Pre-waiting pet setup verification screen
candidates.change: Add a new confirmation screen before the waiting screen to display summary details of the adopted pet.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is 60.9% and users express confusion over pet creation output; a summary verification screen reassures users before processing.

new_pet_summary.headline: Your Pet is Ready to Hatch!
new_pet_summary.body: Review your pet details before entering your desktop habitat.

candidates.title: Waiting screen ready notification toggle
candidates.change: Enable a system notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet generation completes.
candidates.why: The home waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s) and 15.6% drop-off; notification options let users multitask without abandoning.

waiting.hint: We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!

candidates.title: Story screen spotlight layout redesign
candidates.change: Update the story screen to a spotlight layout featuring a prominent animated pet hero element.
candidates.why: Choose_path has a high mean duration (514s); an engaging spotlight intro screen improves initial user momentum.

candidates.title: Adoption certificate official badge
candidates.change: Add a highlighted founder companion badge component to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 60.9% conversion rate; adding a reward component increases completion motivation.

candidates.title: Home intro desktop controls tray hint
candidates.change: Add text and hint components on the final home intro screen explaining desktop tray access and pet interaction shortcuts.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, and 3 reported pet visibility issues.

home_intro.hint: Access your desktop system tray anytime to control or chat with your pet.

components.text: Tip: Right-click your desktop pet for quick settings and actions.

candidates.title: Waiting screen animated companion idle preview
candidates.change: Add an animated hatching pet preview component to the waiting screen while background generation finishes.
candidates.why: Waiting screen median time is 201s and mean time is 2336s; visual engagement prevents drop-off during generation.

candidates.title: Choose path screen headline copy refresh
candidates.change: Rewrite the choose_path screen headline and body to clearly distinguish preset adoption from custom photo creation.
candidates.why: Choose_path mean time is 514s, indicating hesitation when choosing between preset and photo custom paths.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Companion Path
choose_path.body: Select a ready-made desktop pet or create a custom pet from your photos.
